name: Yao Du
title: Postdoc Researcher
bio: I am a Postdoc Researcher at the Joint NTU-WeBank Research Centre on Fintech at Nanyang Technological University in Singapore, working with Prof. Chunyan Miao and Prof. Cyril Leung. My research develops trustworthy and resource-efficient agentic systems for cloud-edge environments, integrating adaptive scheduling, collaborative learning, decentralized coordination, and multimodal inference.
